channel.desc: Chef Joseph Lidgerwood?s class is? A Little Too Special! A K-FOOD experience crafted like no other ? Now Open! As global interest in Korean culture continues to thrive, K-FOOD has become one of its most compelling pillars. And today, people aren?t just curious about how it tastes. They want to learn how it?s made. Joseph Lidgerwood, chef-owner of the Michelin two-star restaurant EVETT, is an Australian chef who has developed a deep connection to Korea?s traditional jang and its ingredients. Now, he?s ready to share what he calls the ?the true taste of Korea.? Each episode welcomes a new group of participants from around the world, learning the all-time favorites such as Korean fried chicken, jaeyuk bokkeum, ganjang gejang, godeungeo kimchijjim, and bajirak sujebi, all reimagined through Joseph?s unique style. The atmosphere in the kitchen, shaped by curiosity, focus, and genuine interaction between Joseph and his students, often becomes as memorable as the food they create. You?ll take home the recipes, of course. But what truly sets this class apart is the moments shared along the way, the laughter, the discoveries, and the way flavor bridges cultures. Experience the depth, joy, and creativity of K-FOOD in Joseph?s A Little Too Special: K-FOOD Class!
